purpose: Offline, non-production vertical slice from the existing HG_E_TIDE_TRACE authority completion to the injected first-six-hours growth settlement runtime. It proves a versioned evidence-to-receipt boundary and never claims a real Y3 map, live economy, or persistent ledger.

scope.first_six_hours_semantics: The vertical slice validates one existing Tide Trace completion against the f6h-v1 offline simulation. It does not define six-hour duration, leveling targets, or production progression throughput.

source_files.purpose: Existing Tide Trace encounter, carrier, and action declaration.
Existing public-map resource, spawn, and action-binding contract.
Existing authority proof, lifecycle, duplicate-event, and postlude state machine.

existing_spawn_contract.meaning: References the existing carrier contract only; this package creates no unit, ability, area, or other Y3 object.

binding_invariants: The offline resolver returns a stable reference with the declared expected type for every resource.
Encounter instance, carrier target, and target lifecycle identity remain within the same public encounter lifecycle.
An offline resolver is test evidence only and must never be described as a real Y3 map binding.

completion_invariants: Completion must use public combat scope and must not carry an instance session identity.
Actor lifecycle, target identity, action, and action token must match the authority reservation.
Only the trusted authority provider may prove a continuous read, completion time, and non-empty proof reference.
The real trace_action_completed command is the canonical evidence projection; the bridge verifier must not reconstruct its fields from caller input.
A replay of the same event identity cannot produce a second encounter completion.

public_eligibility_evidence.producer: Canonical trace_action_completed command from authoritative completion of HG_E_TIDE_TRACE

fixed_context.canonical_projection: completion command payload is consumed directly after trusted verification

non_reward_semantics: Evidence proves an authoritative public interaction completion; it is not an award selection or an inline award payload.
Personal progression evidence, participation chest, rare eligibility, and pity progression cannot be inferred from each other.
Only the injected implementation/growth f6h-v1 offline candidate simulation may consume this evidence inside the trusted boundary; production adoption remains closed.

versioned_reward_settlement_request.direction: implementation/growth offline simulation -> first-six-hours slice settlement boundary
versioned_reward_settlement_request.consumer: Injected growth settlement executor at the vertical-slice boundary
activation_gate: Only the implementation/growth f6h-v1 offline simulation may call vertical_slice_bridge.
Production adoption requires an accepted ECO-LEDGER-002 receipt and idempotency decision.
Production adoption requires an accepted ECO-DROP-001 resource-table, eligibility, and version decision.
Real persistence receipts, map-event adaptation, and multiplayer synchronization must pass independent production gates.

opaque_versioned_fields.source_profile: Resolved by the injected growth resource table; this contract names only the stable profile key.
opaque_versioned_fields.reward_slot_key: Resolved by the injected growth settlement; this contract names only the stable reward slot.
opaque_versioned_fields.reward_grant_ref: A versioned settlement reference, never an embedded item or numeric award.
opaque_versioned_fields.qualification_snapshot_id: Must deterministically bind owner and authoritative source identity fingerprint.
opaque_versioned_fields.owner_id: Must exactly equal the authoritative evidence actor_id; a caller cannot redirect a valid trace completion to another character.

consumers: Tide Trace audit and reconciliation observer
receipt_rules: The same idempotency identity returns its existing receipt or an explicit duplicate_replayed receipt and never changes state twice.
The resource-table version recorded on the offline candidate receipt remains on that receipt; a historical receipt is never silently recalculated.
Evidence, transport, or persistence interruption cannot create two settlement state changes.

failure_retry_and_duplicate_contract.same_event_retry: Must reuse source_identity_fingerprint, request_id, and idempotency_key; it cannot create a second eligibility or reward state change.
failure_retry_and_duplicate_contract.same_id_different_fingerprint: Terminal identity conflict; it cannot create a new settlement.
retry_invariants: A retry keeps the source event, owner, qualification snapshot, and resource-table version unchanged.
Terminal rejection never silently degrades into success or a different reward.
Caller-provided reward amounts, drop probabilities, and pity values are terminally rejected.

acceptance_requirements.assertion: The contract uses only HG_E_TIDE_TRACE, three existing map resources, the existing carrier, and the existing public action.
Offline entry validates map resources and encounter/target identity before it permits authoritative interaction.
Trusted authority proves both begin and completion; caller-provided proof or time is rejected.
Completion first produces public eligibility evidence, not a direct award.
A settlement request references eligibility evidence, a qualification snapshot, and a resource-table version.
Receipt and replay rules prevent a second state mutation for one settlement identity.
Missing evidence, unsupported version, identity conflict, and persistence uncertainty retain terminal or retryable behavior.
The package claims no real Y3 map, no new Y3 objects, and no inline XP, drop, or reward values.

vertical_slice_bridge consumes the canonical Tide Trace completion evidence and validates the injected growth runtime remains an offline candidate with production gate closed, request/evidence versions, owner_id equals evidence.actor_id, instance identity, qualification snapshot, and resource-table version before it calls growth settlement.
One Tide Trace source identity has one settlement idempotency identity; replay returns duplicate_replayed, while conflict identity and inline reward fields cannot mutate the ledger.

unresolved_and_out_of_scope: The slice injects implementation/growth f6h-v1 only inside the trusted Node/Fengari offline boundary; it is not a Y3 runtime binding, production service, or persistent ledger.
f6h-v1 experience, drops, pity, currency, and resource table remain an offline_candidate_simulation_not_adopted and are not a global production baseline.
A real Y3 map, production object IDs, map-root scripts, event adapter, persistent receipt storage, and multiplayer synchronization remain outside this package.
Six-hour duration, chapter coverage, leveling targets, reward throughput, payment, and retention conclusions require independent production decisions.
